name: Averin Capital Acquisition Corp. Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: Averin Capital Acquisition Corp. (ACAA) functions as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), specifically created to pursue a business combination. Its core mission is to execute a strategic transaction, which could involve a merger, a stock swap, the acquisition of assets, a share purchase, or a corporate restructuring, with one or more existing operating businesses. The entity was incorporated on October 17, 2025, and its primary operations are based in New York City.
